correctness.rationale: All face types of the vertex link are enumerated; a contractible core and distinguished triple triangles give integral H2 basis. Each oriented crosspolytope 3-cycle is verified to have zero integral boundary and sends to exactly one primitive link generator. Coordinate adjacent-transposition orientation signs are consistent, yielding a Z[S_n]-equivariant section. The pair LES, van Kampen, Hurewicz and Whitehead establish the stated exactness and previously known nonequivariant topology. The extracted finite checker independently confirms Euler and integer chain identities for n=3..6, but finite checks are not the all-parameter proof.
